Cc: AP Vendor Ops <ap@acmedata.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: AP vendor registration request — Redwood Inference

Hi Stephanie,

We're kicking off vendor enrollment for Redwood so our AP team can accept invoices and route POs correctly. To register you in Acme DataWorks' vendor portal we need the following by end of day Thursday so we can schedule a quick invoice UAT: 

- Legal company name used on tax forms
- Tax ID / VAT number (for EU invoices)
- Remit-to address and preferred currency (USD/EUR)
- Bank details for ACH/Wire (bank name, account type, IBAN/SWIFT when applicable)
- AP contact for purchase-order mapping (who should we map to your PO field?)
- Sample invoice that includes PO number in the body and the tax line broken out
- Completed vendor enrollment form (we can email a link or accept PDF)

AP requirements (important):
- Invoice must contain a PO number in a dedicated field; free-text PO lines are rejected by our matching engine.
- We require invoice PDF + XML (for automation) for throughput > $10k.
- VAT handling: if Redwood issues EU invoices, we need to know whether reverse-charge applies and the VAT ID to validate.

We can create a UAT portal invite so you can submit a test invoice against a test PO and confirm acceptance. Test PO: PO-ACM-RED-0001 (please include exactly as shown). UAT window: Thu 9 Dec 09:00–12:00 PT — tell us what works.

I've attached our AP onboarding packet that describes acceptable invoice layouts and sample XML (acme_ap-onboarding-packet.pdf).

Thanks,
Emily Rhodes
AP Vendor Programs | Acme DataWorks
emily.rhodes@acmedata.com
Attachments: acme_ap-onboarding-packet.pdf (PDF, 1.4MB)

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear checklist and the packet. Looping in Marcus (Finance lead) and Laura (Ops) so we can pull the artifacts and confirm UAT availability.

We can provide all items you listed. Attached: Redwood_vendor_enrollment_form.pdf (completed), redwood_w9.pdf (US tax form), and a sample_invoice.pdf with PO-ACM-RED-0001 in the PO field. A few quick clarifications so we configure the portal correctly:

- PO field mapping: our invoices currently put the PO number in the header field "PO Number" and as an XML tag <PONumber>. Is that compatible with your importer?
- XML schema: is your XML XSD available for quick validation? We can generate XML if you share the namespace and sample.
- VAT: Redwood issues EU invoices from our Irish entity (Redwood Inference EMEA). We will provide VAT ID and indicate reverse-charge where applicable. Does your matching engine expect the VAT ID on both the header and tax-line elements?
- Payment terms & early-pay: what are the effective terms on acceptance for new vendors? Our billing team prefers Net45; if there is early-pay take-up that's fine but we'd like to confirm default terms.

We can join the UAT slot on Thu 9 Dec at 09:30 PT. Marcus and I will submit the test invoice and monitor acceptance.

Thanks — sending attachments now.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Customer Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: vendor_enrollment_form.pdf (PDF), redwood_w9.pdf (PDF), sample_invoice.pdf (PDF)

Stephanie — received, thanks. Quick answers inline:

- PO mapping: Yes, our importer will read a header field labeled "PO Number" or the XML tag <PONumber>. That will map to our PO matching column.
- XML XSD: attaching a lightweight example in the packet; if you need the full XSD I can upload to a shared Drive.
- VAT: put the VAT ID in the header VATNumber and also on the tax line element if reverse-charge applies. We'll validate IDs against EU VIES during onboarding.
- Payment terms: default is Net45 after invoice acceptance. We support early-pay programs but those are opt-in and handled by our Treasury group; you can apply after first invoice acceptance.

Portal invite & UAT: we've created a UAT account for Redwood and sent an invite to stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com. Portal link: https://acmedataworkshop.app.invites/uat/REDWOOD-TEST-001 — use the test credentials and submit the sample_invoice.pdf attached earlier. We will monitor acceptance and share the audit/log trace.

Test PO to use: PO-ACM-RED-0001
VAN/EDI: if you plan to EDI for high-volume, we require VAN ID 55-ACM-VAN; we can provide EDI onboarding separately.

Attached: AP onboarding packet (you should have it), and a short onboarding checklist. If anything fails on validation during UAT, we'll post the rejection reason in the portal audit.

Talk soon — see you Thu 09:30 PT.

Emily
Attachments: none (portal invite link provided)

- Tax / VAT: Redwood will flag reverse-charge on EU invoices and include the EMEA VAT ID (IE1234567V). If your system needs a document for zero-rated VAT we can provide a certificate — please advise which field to upload.
